saints.name: St. John of Capistrano
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: A Franciscan preacher and reformer who, at seventy, rallied the defenders of Belgrade against the Turks…
biography: Born at Capestrano in the Abruzzi in 1386, John trained as a lawyer and served as governor of Perugia before a term of imprisonment turned him to God; he entered the Friars Minor and became one of the most powerful preachers of his age. With St. Bernardine of Siena he worked for the reform of the Franciscan Observants and traveled across Europe drawing great crowds.

In his old age he was sent to preach against the advancing Ottoman armies, and in 1456 he helped inspire and lead the Christian forces who broke the siege of Belgrade. Worn out by his labors, he died a few months later. He was canonized in 1690 and is honoured as a patron of military chaplains.
saints.knownFor: Preaching reform and rallying the defense of Belgrade.
